title: Tenant Wars (Demo)
overview:
Lots of Real-Life Stores Appear
Aim to Be the Top Tenant Owner!

Family and friends can all have a blast playing together, meow.

Tenant Wars is a board game set in a shopping mall. Roll your way around the board, open shops in the spaces you land on, and grow your business. When a rival stops at one of your shops, they have to buy something there. The player with the most money at the end wins.

Real Japanese chains line the mall, including Denny's, Lotteria, TSUTAYA, Autobacs, H.I.S., Matsumoto Kiyoshi and Yofuku no Aoyama.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-6 players
- Multi-terminal 6 support
- Real-life stores

実際にあるお店もたくさん登場
目指せトップテナントオーナー！

家族や友だち、みんなでワイワイ遊べるニャ。
